looks.label: Mature skin / warm hazel
looks.skin_height_encoding: 16-bit UNORM; shader bump distance defines physical amplitude
looks.eye_uv_contract: GNM native eye-interior disk; pupil radius .04985 UV, iris radius .18492 UV; separate L/R maps

seam_refinement.method: Paired native cut-edge color constraints with smooth local correction on both charts
seam_refinement.scope: Albedo cut continuity only; render review still required. Geometry and UV coordinates are unchanged.

skin_detail_source.author: Lee Perry-Smith / Infinite-Realities
skin_detail_source.method: Landmark-registered frontal high-frequency detail; native UVs unchanged; authored amplitude, not measured deformation

iris_source.origin: Original AI-authored appearance texture; source pupil and limbus registered to native GNM annulus

looks.modifications: CC0 diffuse transferred onto native GNM UVs, scalp/lip corrections, seam feathering and attributed scan microdetail. Original iris plate annulus-registered and color-varied per look; procedural scleral vessels. No metric or photographic ground-truth claim for the appearance assets.
